articles.title: KuCoin Australia MD James Pinch at Crypto Winter 2026: Trust and Familiarity Will Shape the Future of Agentic Commerce
articles.description: **media[1197135]**QUEENSTOWN, New Zealand, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- James Pinch, Managing Director of KuCoin in Australia, spoke at Crypto Winter 2026 in Queenstown, on a panel titled 'Stablecoins and Agentic AI: powering the future of online commerce.' Moderated by Jasmine Wilson, the session examined what agentic finance looks like in practice and what must be true for it to scale safely. Pinch said the strongest live use of agent-initiated stablecoin payments is still narrow and mostly invisible: machines buying inputs from other machines, in small amounts and at high frequency, with no person involved. What is new, he argued, is not speed but the transaction models these payments enable.

articles.title: Baidu Announces Dual-Primary Listing on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited
articles.description: BEIJING, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Baidu, Inc. ('Baidu' or the 'Company') (Nasdaq: BIDU; HKEX: 9888 (HKD Counter) and 89888 (RMB Counter)), a leading AI company with strong Internet foundation, today announced that the Company's voluntary conversion of its secondary listing status to dual-primary listing on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (the 'Hong Kong Stock Exchange') became effective today. Baidu is now a dual-primary listed company on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in Hong Kong SAR and the Nasdaq Global Select Market in the United States.
